# dsh-plugin-steward · 插件管家
English · 中文
`dsh-plugin-steward` adds one button to the composer (🧩 插件) and one settings page. Its host half reg

isters a few
same-origin HTTP routes inside the running harness process; its client half is a single

unbundled module loaded by
the web UI. It starts no extra process and stores no credentials.
## English
### What it does
| Feature | Behaviour |
| Catalog | Lists every installed bundle (third-party and built-in) and every loader row with title,

version, description, package name and current state. |
| Global on/off | Bundles go through `plugi
nManager.setBundleEnabled`, rows through `setPluginEnabled`. The result is reported as applied / res
tart-required / overridden / failed. The plugin refuses to disable itself (HTTP 409) so the entry po

int cannot disappear. |
| Per-plugin settings | The ⚙ next to each row opens a settings drawer. The
host reads that row's schemastery `Config` and derives the form: string, number (with min/max), bool
ean, enum and JSON controls, each with default and a `reload` marker when the field is volatile. Sav

ing sends only changed fields through `configEditor.edit()`. |
| Per-conversation gating | The **Thi
s conversation** tab hides a plugin's tools or a whole MCP server from the model for one conversatio
n. It calls `agent.ctx.tools.restrict()` on that agent, so it applies to an already-running conversa
tion from the next request. Policies are saved per session and re-applied after a reload or restart.

|
| Automatic descriptions | When a plugin ships no `meta.description`, the host derives one senten
ce (≤ 90 chars) from the plugin's own README, client slot ids or `package.json`. Author-written desc

riptions always win; ✨ regenerates on demand and the source is labelled. |
| AI Chinese labels | The
中 button asks the current default model to read the plugin's own README, `package.json` and client
slot ids, and write a short Chinese label + one-line summary + 2–4 keywords as JSON. Results are sto
red in `tags.json`, so they survive reloads and restarts, and the label replaces the English package
name in the list. If the model answers with prose, the host re-asks once, then falls back to a rule

-based label. Can be turned off in Settings. |
| Compact rows, expandable | Rows show only the name
(and badges) by default; ▸ expands to 作用 (what it does) and 使用说明 (how to use it), plus keywords and

the package name. |
[该节后续省略]
### How to use it
1. Click **🧩 插件** at the left of the composer tool row. With a session in context the panel lands on

**本对话**; otherwise on **全局**.
2. Pick a scope at the top:
- **全局** switches the real profile compos

ition (every conversation). It goes through the platform's plugin
manager and may report `restart re

quired`.
- **本对话** only hides the chosen plugin's tools / MCP servers for this one conversation. It

takes effect on the
next request, also for conversations that already started.
3. Expand a row (clic

k its name or ▸) to read **作用** (what it does) and **使用说明** (how to use it), plus
keywords and the p

ackage name.
4. Buttons at the right of a row:
| Control | What it does |
| switch | Global: load / unload that bundle or row. This conversation: allow / hide its tools for t

his conversation. |
| ⚙ | Open that row's settings (only when the row declares a `Config`). |
| ✨ |

Re-derive the description from the plugin's own files. |
| 中 | Ask the default model to write the Ch

inese label / summary / usage; remembered in `tags.json`. |
| 🔒 | Kernel bundle: always on, listed f

or reference only. |
| ? | This usage page. |
5. Drag the title bar to move the panel; double-click to snap back. **设置 → 插件管家** holds the discover

y switch,
the AI-label switch, the data paths and the per-conversation policy list.
### Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install the directory itself as a bundle with the plugin manager:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle adds one row to the composition:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Reload the Web UI once (the client half is injected at page load). After editing the source,
`set_pl
ugin` on `include:plugin-console` with `enabled: false` then `true`.
### HTTP routes
All routes are same-origin under `/plugin-console/api` and are called by the client half.
| Method | Path | Purpose |
| GET | `/catalog` | Full catalog, discovery state, `kernel` section, `profileBundles`; `?ack=1` als

o acknowledges |
| GET | `/status` | Pending count (orange dot) and client-half load state |
| POST

| `/toggle` | `{kind:'bundle'\|'row', id, enabled}` |
| POST | `/ack` | Record the current plugin se

t as known |
| GET | `/config?id=<entryId>` | Derived form description and explicit values for one l

oader row |
| POST | `/config` | `{id, config}` → validated, persisted and reloaded by the Loader |

| GET | `/sessions` | Running sessions plus every saved per-conversation policy |
| GET | `/session?
id=<sessionId>` | Gate view for one session: visible tools, tools grouped by plugin, MCP servers, de

nied list |
| POST | `/session` | `{id, disabled: string[], disabledMcp: string[]}` → saved and appl

ied immediately |
| DELETE | `/session?id=<sessionId>` | Clear one conversation's policy and revoke

its restriction |
| GET/POST | `/settings` | Discovery settings (auto-acknowledge) and the AI-label

switch |
| GET | `/describe?id=<package>&refresh=1` | Derive a description from the plugin's own fil

es |
| GET | `/tags` | Remembered AI labels for every plugin |
| POST | `/tags` | `{packageName}` →

ask the default model, store and return the label |
| DELETE | `/tags?packageName=<package>` | Forge
t one plugin's label |
### Files written

- `<profile>/.plugin-console/state.json` — known bundles/rows, pending discoveries, settings.
- `<pr
ofile>/.plugin-console/sessions/<sessionId>.json` — per-conversation policy (`disabled`, `disabledMc

p`).
- `<profile>/.plugin-console/tags.json` — AI labels remembered per package name.
Nothing else is modified; global switching goes through the platform's own plugin manager.
### Limits
- **Pure UI plugins (wallpaper, widgets, sidebars) cannot be toggled per conversation.** Client plug

ins load at
profile level and their slot registrations are global. For those the steward offers glob

al on/off and a way to
